correctness.rationale: Averaging arbitrary ellipsoid sandwich inequalities over permutations globally reduces the infimum to Q_beta. The exact dual inverse yields U; convexity and full slab-cube vertex geometry yield V. For beta<=beta0, pointwise Cauchy-Schwarz makes P nonincreasing; for beta>=beta0 a positive increasing derivative numerator F makes P strictly increasing. The closed form, edge t=1, limit t→∞, and exact sign of derivatives are reconstructed. A standalone standard-library exact-rational checker passed 72 parameter cases and 8,530 assertions, supplementing rather than replacing the universal proof.
